contacts.name: Haruna 'Protocol' Bello
contacts.bio: Knows which door, which gate, which aide and which aunty. Charges by the introduction. Loyal to whoever paid last — usually.

contacts.name: Zainab Yusuf-Cole
contacts.bio: Runs an independent news channel from a Wuze Market back office. Has been sued eleven times. Won eleven times.

contacts.name: Chief Barnabas 'Big Bar' Okon
contacts.bio: Chairman of committees nobody has heard of. Owns three foundations named after himself. Entirely fictional, entirely too familiar.

contacts.name: Capt. Dayo Ige
contacts.bio: Flies anyone, anywhere, for cash and good music. Unlocks helicopter and jet charters.

missions.title: Welcome to the Capital
missions.summary: Haruna meets you at arrivals. 'In Abuja, you are who drives you. Today, you drive someone important.' Chauffeur a nervous aide without scratching the sedan.

objectives.text: Take the wheel of the black sedan
Get the aide to the Federal Unity Secretariat on time

missions.title: Estate Rounds
missions.summary: A night shift as estate security in Maiden Hills. Check the gates, catch the 'generator thief', and notice who visits Big Bar's neighbour at 2am.

missions.title: Wuze Market Whispers
missions.summary: Zainab has the other half of the Port Harcourt story. Meet her in Wuze Market — and don't lead Big Bar's people to her.

objectives.text: Bonus: catch the man following you

missions.title: Black Tie, Big Lies
missions.summary: Big Bar's 'Foundation for Transparency' gala at Grand Unity Hall. Dress the part — agbada or a sharp suit — work the room and photograph the donor list.

missions.title: Siren Season
missions.summary: Big Bar's convoy is moving the real files out of the city. Seventeen SUVs, one has the hard drives. Find the right one at 160 km/h.

objectives.text: Get something that can keep up

missions.title: Rock and a Hard Place
missions.summary: Haruna set up a 'meeting' at Iron Crown Rock. It's an ambush. Survive, and find out who Haruna is really working for.

objectives.text: Spare Haruna... or cut him off

missions.title: The Ledger
missions.summary: The original ledger is in Big Bar's Asoro Gardens villa. Cameras, dogs, and a guard who only watches football. Wait for the match.

missions.title: Rotor Wash
missions.summary: Big Bar has locked down the city. Every road has a checkpoint. Capt. Dayo has a helicopter on a Maiden Hills roof — get there and fly out.

missions.title: Big Man Down
missions.summary: Zainab goes live from the Central Axis with everything you've gathered across three cities. Big Bar will throw everything at the broadcast van. Hold the line — then decide who you've become.

objectives.text: Escort the broadcast van to the Central Axis

missions.title: Charter Flight
missions.summary: A nervous diplomat needs a quiet helicopter ride to the outskirts. No questions, no turbulence.

hustles.name: VIP Chauffeur
hustles.description: Drive the important and the self-important. Smooth driving, punctuality and silence are tipped.

hustles.name: Estate Security
hustles.description: Night patrols in Maiden Hills. Catch intruders, log visitors, overhear secrets.

businesses.name: Protocol Car Hire
businesses.description: Black sedans for people who need to look important.

businesses.name: Capital Lounge
businesses.description: Where deals are made over small chops. You hear everything.
